description: This file manages interactions with the system keychain, including ensuring access, retrieving, setting, and deleting stored credentials, specifically for the 'Standard Notes' account within an Electron application.

classes.name: KeychainInterface
classes.description: Interface defining keychain-related methods for external use.

methods.name: ensureKeychainAccess
methods.description: Checks and requests access to the system keychain, prompting the user if necessary.

methods.name: askForKeychainAccess
methods.description: Creates a window to ask the user for keychain access permissions.

methods.name: getKeychainValue
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the stored keychain password value.

methods.name: setKeychainValue
methods.description: Stores a value in the keychain after serializing it to JSON.
